main.description: Views of accounts, and of posts by accounts, that Bluesky's AppView withholds and a listed community still serves. Named accounts not yet known are checked in the background and reported in `pending`; ask again a little later. Everything else is omitted, a malformed DID or URI included (the rest are answered). Any signed-in caller.

servedAs.description: The form this answer was served in: `member` (a ready member, with its stored viewer state) or `visitor` (anyone else).

withheld.description: Named items held back for a reason that is not final. A named item absent from profiles, posts, pending and withheld is final: not hosted by a listed community, rejected, taken down here, deleted or not restored.

pending.description: Accounts accepted for checking and not served yet. An account whose check found it on no listed community is left out for a day.
